summary: A new price that carries no times: after Shoonya's snapshot with its feed time (ft), trade time (ltt) and change (pc), a partial with only a new lp goes out without the old feed time, trade time or change percent (worked out again from the new price), and a partial with only a new volume keeps the price's own (absent) times (audit R107-10).

notes: Lead decision (review-fixes.md): a per-packet time never carries over. The web's adapter merges every raw key into its cache and so sends the old ft and ltt (and the old pc) with the new price: declared as web defects.
Client a holds Quote and client b LTP on one touchline subscription.
